company.name: Pahdo Labs
company.shortDescription: Pahdo Labs develops an Anime-style action MMORPG and game creation platform.
company.description:
Pahdo Labs is building an Anime-style action MMORPG and game creation platform. The company's mission is to cultivate a virtual world built by players, an online place where people can have a meaningful role in something bigger than themselves, own and share the products of their ingenuity, and foster a sense of belonging for others.

Pahdo Labs was founded in 2021 and is based in New York, NY.
